contentText: Across the United States, arrests by ICE agents - and protests against them  - continue. As Donald Trump's immigration crackdown has intensified, more and more videos have gained traction online, showing ICE arrests filmed by bystanders. And whilst there are verified videos showing aggression by federal agents, not all the videos are authentic. In Truth or Fake, Vedika Bahl goes through what's real and what's misleading.
